ds_about_headline.en: This is not DeepSeek's official app.

ds_about_intro.en: Read this page before deciding to use it.
ds_about_intro.zh-CN: 请先读完这一页，再决定是否继续使用。

ds_about_who_body.en: DeepSeek Unlimited is a third-party open-source client. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or authorized by DeepSeek or Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Basic Technology Research Co., Ltd. “DeepSeek” is a trademark of its owner and is used here only to describe the connected API service. The whale artwork in the app is a placeholder; no official asset is included.
ds_about_who_body.zh-CN: DeepSeek 无限制版是一个第三方开源客户端，与杭州深度求索人工智能基础技术研究有限公司及 DeepSeek 官方没有隶属、合作、授权或背书关系。\n\n“DeepSeek”是其权利人的商标，本项目中仅用于说明所连接的 API 服务。App 内的鲸鱼图形是原创占位图形，不包含官方素材。

ds_about_data_body.en: Conversations, messages, settings and the API key are stored only on this phone. System backup and device-to-device transfer are disabled for this app. We do not run an account server or a cloud database. Messages are sent directly to api.deepseek.com when you chat; that is unavoidable when using the API. To switch phones, export your conversations to a ZIP on the old device and import it on the new one. Uninstalling the app or clearing app data will permanently lose local conversations.
ds_about_data_body.zh-CN:
对话、消息、设置和 API Key 只存储在这台手机上。本 App 已禁止 Android 系统备份与换机迁移；本项目不运营账号服务器，也没有云端数据库；我们看不到你的聊天记录，也无法替你恢复。

发送消息时，App 会把对话内容直接发送到 api.deepseek.com，由 DeepSeek 的服务器处理。这是使用 API 无法绕开的一步。

换机时请在旧设备导出对话 ZIP，再在新设备导入。卸载 App 或清除应用数据会导致本机对话永久丢失。

ds_about_cost_body.en: This app is free; it does not sell keys or top-ups. DeepSeek bills API usage directly to your account balance. Web search and link reading also incur official charges. Top up on the DeepSeek platform if your balance is low.
ds_about_cost_body.zh-CN: 本 App 不收费、不代充、不卖 Key、不抽成。API 的使用费用由 DeepSeek 按实际用量计费，直接从你的 DeepSeek 账户余额中扣除。\n\n联网搜索、阅读链接等工具调用也会产生官方费用。余额不足时，请前往 DeepSeek 开放平台充值；本 App 不提供绕过官方计费的“免费额度”。

ds_about_unlimited_body.en: It means this app imposes no message count, duration, edit count or retention limit. It does not mean the API is free or has unlimited tokens, nor does it override DeepSeek's balance, rate limits, risk controls or account policies.
ds_about_unlimited_body.zh-CN: 它只表示：这个 App 不设置次数、时长、修改次数或对话保留期限的限制。没有“今天聊够了”的提示，也不会因为你几天没来就清空对话。\n\n它不表示 API 永久免费、无限 token，或不受 DeepSeek 的余额、速率限制、风控与账号政策约束。那些边界仍然存在，而且由 DeepSeek 决定。

ds_about_risk_title.zh-CN: 你需要自己承担的风险

ds_about_risk_body.en: AI output may be wrong; verify it and do not treat it as medical, legal or financial advice. Do not use the app for illegal activity. You are responsible for losses caused by your usage, a leaked API key, or account restrictions. Never share your API key.
ds_about_risk_body.zh-CN:
AI 生成的内容可能出错，请自行核实，不要把它当作医疗、法律或财务建议。

请勿使用本 App 从事违法活动。因使用方式、API Key 泄露、账号被限制或封禁造成的损失，需由使用者自行承担。

API Key 一旦泄露，他人可以花掉你账户里的钱。不要把 Key 发给任何人，也不要截图分享。

ds_about_license_body.en: This project is based on the open-source GPT Mobile project. Upstream uses GPL-3.0, so this project is released under GNU GPL-3.0, not MIT. You may view, modify and distribute the code under GPL-3.0; redistributed modified versions must keep the same license and source availability.
